To multiply a complex number by a purely imaginary number, we use the distributive property and the fact that $\textrm{i}^2 = -1.$

For the given problem, we have

$$
\begin{aligned}6\,\text{i}\cdot (4+2\,\text{i}) & =6\,\text{i}\cdot 4+6\,\text{i}\cdot 2\,\text{i} \\  & =4\cdot 6\,\text{i}+6\cdot 2\cdot \,{\text{i}}^{2} \\  & =24\,\text{i}+12\cdot (-1) \\  & =24\,\text{i}-12 \\  & =-12+24\,\text{i}.\end{aligned}
$$
